defs.def: unusual or surprising in a way that causes people to take notice 非凡的；奇异的；显著的；引人注目的adv.

ex.s: Roland Reisley turned 101 years old in May and is in remarkable health.
ex.t: Roland Reisley今年5月满101岁，身体状况非常好。

ex.s: The Palace Museum has the most remarkable collection of fine clocks in the world, mainly _________ from Europe and China.
ex.t: 故宫博物院拥有世界上最精美的钟表收藏，主要_________来自欧洲和中国。

ex.s: After two years, the second group saw remarkable improvements in heart health.
ex.t: 两年后，第二组在心脏健康方面看到显著改善。

ex.s: He showed us that even a single desire, never given up on, can make for a remarkable life.
ex.t: 他向我们展示，哪怕只是一个永不放弃的愿望，也能成就非凡的人生。

ex.s: All of this makes the actions of the homeless Tom Smith    17    more remarkable.
ex.t: 所有这些都让无家可归者汤姆·史密斯的行为____17____更加了不起。

ex.s: In this spirit, the Laureus World Sports Awards is an annual ceremony to honour remarkable sportspeople.
ex.t: 本着这种精神，劳伦斯世界体育奖是一年一度的颁奖典礼，旨在表彰杰出的运动员。

ex.s: If you saw him, you’d never think there was anything remarkable about him.
ex.t: 如果你看到他，你绝不会想到他有什么引人注目的地方。

ex.s: This was a remarkable achievement by the Chinese team of scientists, in such a short space of time.
ex.t: 这是中国科学家团队在如此短的时间内取得的非凡成就。

ex.s: With their remarkable skills, innovation, diligence and humility, the Lei family leave behind their buildings and the legacy that true craftwork is a treasure that can last beyond a lifetime.
ex.t: 凭借他们卓越的技能、创新、勤奋和谦逊，雷氏家族留下的不仅是建筑，还有这样一种遗产：真正的工艺是一种超越一生的宝藏。

ex.s: During his studies and working life, Lu developed a remarkable command of English, as well as of his native Chinese.
ex.t: 在求学和工作中，陆谷孙不仅精通母语中文，而且对英语也有了非凡的掌握。
